packages.label: נֹעַם וּמוֹחִין שֶׁל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל
packages.label_en: Pleasantness and the Minds of the Land of Israel
packages.reason: All these nodes share the essential nature of נועם — the quality of harmonious, pleasant, luminous consciousness rooted in Eretz Yisrael. יוסף, described as יפה תואר (beautiful of appearance), is identified with נועם because 'תואר — שמראה פנים בהלכה', i.e., showing the pleasant/illuminating face of Torah. שפרה (beauty/pleasantness) links to שפיר ושליא (the afterbirth/vessel of birth) and to הולדה (procreation itself), all as expressions of the beautiful, nourishing, generative quality that flows from נועם. The 'loving flames' (שלהובין דרחימותא) and אהבה are the experiential form that נועם takes when it awakens the heart. מחין and מוחין של ארץ ישראל are all aspects of the same conscious luminosity. The good mirror of the חובלים package: where those minds are discordant and wounding, these minds are harmonious, pleasant, and life-generating.

merge_notes.reason: This isolated pair (raw component D) was a two-node component. אהבה is a bechina of שלהובין דרחימותא (flames of desire). Both are the experiential quality of נועם as it arouses the heart — they are not a separate domain but the form נועם takes in the heart. The proof text reads: 'על ידי נועם העליון מתעורר האהבה, בחינת שלהובין דרחימותא'. They belong to Package 1 as the affective/inner dimension of נועם העליון.

This isolated pair (raw component E) records the equation 'כל המוחין הם בחינת מוחין של ארץ ישראל' from the opening of the Torah. מוחין and מחין are alternate spellings of the same word (minds/intellects). מוחין של ארץ ישראל and מחין של ארץ ישראל are the same concept. These nodes are aliases of nodes already in the main נועם component (component A), and the bechina they express — that all minds draw from the Eretz Yisrael source — is the same as edges 3 and 16 in that component. They belong in Package 1.

packages.label: צְדָקָה וְיַעֲקֹב
packages.reason: These nodes share the essential nature of נדיבות לב — the quality of generous, open-hearted giving. יעקב is a bechina of צדקה (as written: 'משפט וצדקה ביעקב אתה עשית'). נחלת (inheritance/portion) is equated with יעקב via 'יעקב חבל נחלתו'. תרומה (the offering/contribution) is equated with צדקה because it is the paradigm of נדיבות לב: 'מאת כל איש אשר ידבנו לבו תקחו את תרומתי'. נדיבות לב and שנפתח ונתנדב הלב are two aspects of the same quality: the open, giving heart. All these nodes represent the vessel-making dimension of the Torah — the capacity to receive through generosity. צדקה is the instrument that creates the כלי (vessel) to receive נועם העליון, but the nodes within this package share the same NATURE (giving, open-heartedness, the Jacob-energy of generosity), even though צדקה's FUNCTION is to produce results (that is eitza, connecting this package to Package 1).

packages.label: חוֹבְלִים וּמוֹחִין שֶׁל חוּץ לָאָרֶץ
packages.reason: These nodes share the essential nature of חובלים — the quality of discordant, wounding, conflicting consciousness that results from פגם הכבוד (desecration of God's honor). מוחין של חוץ לארץ are called חובלים because they cannot harmonize with each other (the Gemara in Sanhedrin: 'חובלים — אלו תלמידי חכמים שבחוץ לארץ, שחובלים זה לזה בהלכה'). חבלי לדה (birth pangs) are identified as a bechina of חובלים because they represent the suffering/difficulty side of the birth process — the painful, convulsive dimension that needs to be repaired through נועם. This is the evil mirror of Package 1: where Package 1 is נועם/harmony/pleasant-minds, Package 3 is חובלים/discord/wounding-minds. The repair of these minds is the Torah's practical teaching.
